title: Beetle Clock Tower
description: A surreal gothic scene featuring a decayed zombie-like man in a green suit and hat firing a handgun at a giant green stag beetle in the foreground. Behind them stands an ornate gothic cathedral clock tower overgrown with ivy, its clock face showing 12 o'clock. Ethereal winged female figures float nearby holding transparent spheres containing horses and a spiral, while smaller spheres show a cathedral and a moonlit landscape.
prompt: A dark surreal gothic illustration shows a decayed zombie gentleman in a tattered green suit and fedora firing a pistol with white muzzle flash at a giant detailed green stag beetle. In the background an ornate ivy-covered gothic cathedral clock tower displays 12 o'clock. Floating winged angelic women in white dresses hold transparent orbs containing black horses and a spiral pattern, while smaller spheres show a miniature cathedral and a crescent moon landscape against a black background with dripping white paint effects.
